summary.text: In March 2026, Billingsley said it is essential to enable banks to adopt AI and other technologies while maintaining expectations that they manage risks and operate safely and soundly. He described banks' increasing use of AI and machine learning in fraud detection, AML/CFT, credit underwriting, and GenAI testing for customer questions, call summaries, coding, and loan information. He said the FDIC is piloting GenAI for internal staff use and investing in AI workforce training that emphasizes AI literacy, critical evaluation, data protection, and human oversight. He also cited potential promise in AI for fraud alert monitoring, transaction testing, and offsite analytics, and supported more whole-of-government coordination and information sharing.
